turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
I'm not here to advise you on your job. What are you basing the zero on?
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
I'm sorry about your nephew, Hale, but that's yours to work out. Owen's essay. What are you basing the zero on?
